issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() should return a double, but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning an int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and leads to integer division in the solution instead of a fractional result.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the method signature in Lecture to return double and compute using floating-point division, e.g. public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); }. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to indicate an int return type if integer division was intended.
